John '''Wicktorio''' is the mayor of Egla Town, who is a retired Acolyte and accountant of the [[Order of the Deep|Order]]. After the passing of his wife, her Echo named Daisy, appeared to keep him company for the next twenty-years.
That is until an unfortunate event occurred.

He can be found with [[Cosimo]] in front of an overgrown and abandon house during 07:00 to 10:00, seemingly with regrets.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Daytime, in front of the abandoned house)
:'''Cosimo:''' Heh... How many years have we been strolling here every morning?
:'''Wicktorio:'''  I can't remember. My memory is not what it used to be. We're just old fools approaching the grave.
:'''Cosimo:''' Every time I see this house, I feel as if the child's right before me...
:'''Cosimo:''' Oh Imperator, is her fate also part of your design?

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Wicktorio:''' Welcome to Egla Town, traveler from afar. May you enjoy your time here.
:'''Wicktorio:''' I'm Wicktorio, the mayor. Feel free to ask me about anything related to the town.
:{{DIcon|Option}}: Could you tell me about the history of this place?
::'''Wicktorio:''' Certainly, not many young people care about history these days...
::'''Wicktorio:''' The history of our town begins with the first settlers in Rinascita. Later, The Order united the people during the [[Dark Tide]] and established a city-state. Over time, Ragunna City became the cultural and life center of the region.
::'''Wicktorio:''' Egla has managed to preserve its original essense due to its relatively peaceful enviornment, thus placing greater importance on the traditions of Ragunna.
:{{DIcon}}: What do you recommend here?
::'''Wicktorio:''' You can find the most traditional Ragunna cuisine at the Burrata Bakery, or immerse yourself in town life at the Sorrentino Inn.
::'''Wicktorio:''' Or... you could quietly hide behind the curtains at night and enjoy the Night Reveries, prepared for the knights.
:{{DIcon}}: About the unattended house.
::'''Wicktorio:''' The house you're talking about... That family left Rinascita nearly twenty years ago.
::'''Wicktorio:''' It's just old news, not worth delving into. Please don't concern yourself with it.
:{{DIcon}}: Thank you. See you around.
::'''Wicktorio:''' Goodbye, foreign visitor. May the glory of the Sentinel be with you.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
*Wicktorio is a reference to the popular fictional character {{W|John Wick (character)|John Wick}}.
*There is a book referred by [[Julia]] where Wicktorio is an accountant of the Montelli family instead.
